summary: Frontend-only E2E test (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390) of The Retention Lab. ~95% of the requested flows work: nav and mobile nav, hero CTAs, Competitive, Cohort lab (all 5 shadcn filters, channel pills, KPIs, reset, persistence, row detail open/close, 4 tabs, CSV download, data story), Rescue studio (both journeys, tally plus persistence, 6 hypotheses), Lifecycle (9 journeys, 3 personas, Priya SMS suppressed, A/B simulate/save/delete/persist), Experiments (ICE re-rank, sample size/duration, reset), CLV (sliders, warning, load synthetic, reset), HCI (both modes, annotations, delay/undo, swap, cancel->confirm->reactivate), Roadmap (phases plus persisted checks), Methodology accordion, LinkedIn CTA. No horizontal overflow at 390px. No page errors. Found 1 functional UX bug (A/B recipients input) and 3 small issues.

ui_bugs.component: LifecycleStudio A/B builder - Recipients per arm
ui_bugs.issue: Users cannot type a number in this field. onChange clamps on every keystroke (Math.max(200, Number(v)||200)). After the field is cleared it snaps back to 200, so typing '3000' gives '2003000', which then clamps to 100000. Reproduced by typing with the keyboard.
value={hyp || defaultHyp}: the textarea cannot be emptied. Deleting all the text puts the default hypothesis back right away (211 chars after fill('')).
When improvement = 0% the card shows '$-0.00' (float -0 / sign placed after the $). Format as '−$0.00' or clamp tiny negative values to 0.

exp-reset-ice resets only the ICE scores. Baseline/MDE sample-size sliders keep their changed values (sample size stayed 4,007 after Reset). Either rename the button or also reset the sample-size sliders.

issues: Sonner toasts (bottom-right) sit on top of the sticky cohort detail panel and HCI annotation rows for a moment. Cosmetic only.
Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1)' for charts inside inactive tabs. Harmless, but you could add minWidth/minHeight to ResponsiveContainer or render charts only when their tab is active.

action_items: Fix ab-sample-size-input: keep the raw string in state and clamp to 200..100000 on blur or before running the simulation, not on every keystroke
Let the hypothesis textarea be emptied (use hyp ?? defaultHyp with null as the initial value, or seed state with the default)
Optional: make Experiments Reset also reset the sample-size sliders, or rename it 'Reset ICE'
critical_code_review_comments: usePersist reads JSON from localStorage with no schema check. If the Filters/Inputs shape changes later, old stored objects could crash the app (e.g. filters.channels undefined). Consider merging with defaults: {...initial, ...parsed}.
Rescue tally counts the Original-journey 'Keep my subscription' result as 'retained'. That may be intended, but it mixes original and proposed outcomes in one tally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app, all state in localStorage under the 'retention-lab:' prefix (clear it before each run). Shadcn select options use the testid pattern {selectTestId}-option-{value-lowercased-dashed}. Radix sliders: focus '[data-testid=X] [role=slider]' and press ArrowRight/End/Home. Smooth scroll needs ~1.5-3s on long jumps. Everything in the review request was verified except copy-to-clipboard (data-story-copy-btn), which was not tested.
